gaps.lead: I'd rather not go to the meeting.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't feel like doing' = not want to do.

gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: Even though she was exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.sentence: ___ exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though she was' becomes 'in spite of being' — concession + gerund.

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.
